explication: Nuvio is a cross-platform media-browsing and playback app; the README focuses on its tvOS experience, while the tree also shows a substantial Kotlin Multiplatform app. The principal journey is browsing catalogs, choosing content and a configured source, then playing it. The graph keeps browsing, source resolution, playback, and account/integration capabilities distinct. Source excerpts are limited, so unverified implementation links are dashed and have no evidence path.
